description: Fan a multi-item input out to one output endpoint per item (e.g. Canvas → Spaces → one handle per space). Feeds each item downstream individually.
instructions:
Fan-out — takes ONE multi-item input bundle (spaces / segments / graphs / points) and exposes each item on its own output handle (out-0, out-1, …). The handle count tracks the live input count.

TIP: put it after a Canvas → Spaces output (or any 'single' bundle) to drive each item down its own branch.
